purpose: Repeat five servo startup/steady comparisons and longer PI experiment with simultaneous physical PPS and serial observations.
platform: UNO R4 Minima pair with AX88279 TimeSticks and MAX3421E shields
master: Free-running; flashed once with the archived image; may reinitialize when follower upload drops the link.
phase_control: None. Upload-triggered startup is not an equal imposed phase step.

analysis.cutoff_origin: Saleae capture start, for both physical PPS and host-receipt serial timing
analysis.qualification: Complete continuous high and preceding low each 490 to 510 ms; no phase-based outlier rejection. Preserve all raw transitions and excluded observations.
analysis.pairing: Unique corresponding qualified edges within +/-100 ms; report unmatched observations. PPS alone does not identify integer-second offsets.
analysis.physical_sign: Follower edge minus grandmaster edge; positive means follower later.
analysis.statistics: Counts, mean, population standard deviation, RMS about zero, min/max, full and post-cutoff windows.
analysis.transients: Plot physical and serial acquisition separately, without claiming equal initial conditions or causal servo ranking.

known_limits: Earlier captures showed extra transitions; do not call the stream glitch-free or infer their cause.
One sequential trial per condition is exploratory, not a replicated performance ranking.
No instrument calibration, external timebase, UTC reference, temperature measurement, or controlled disturbance.
end_state: Restore fixed PI by finishing with pi-steady; preserve logs on failure.
